{{Quote|His name's Zian; he represents a tiny little rock in the middle of some very profitable trade lanes.|Jonas Balkar|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Solu Five''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] along several profitable [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]. During the [[Galactic War]], the planet was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Grom Zian]].

==Behind the scenes==
Solu Five was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in a press release that Trooper players receive if they choose to expose Senator Zian's treason.
